name: B10-0423/2026 – After § 7 – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 7a. Underlines that secondary paid activities carried out by Members of the European Parliament may create conflicts of interest, in particular where Members act as consultants, managers, lawyers or advisers for private companies or interest representatives, sit on management, supervisory or advisory boards, or receive retainers, attendance fees or other forms of recurring remuneration from external entities; considers that such situations may compromise the independence of Members in the exercise of their mandate and public confidence in the integrity of Parliament’s decision-making process;
